Alternatives to the Polaroid Originals Instant Postcards?
I really liked the ability to create a fun postcard with a Polaroid but sadly the little kits haven’t been made in ages and no one has them in stock anymore. Is there a way to make your own or alternatives out there? Seems so strange Polaroid hasn’t done at least a small batch of them, I’m sure people would be all over it.
